decisions.reason: The chart plugin had strong release momentum and remains a natural extension of the established map.apps portfolio, so it is likely retained.
As the flagship platform central to the firm's strategic direction, it is very unlikely to be dropped.
Mobile field data capture aligns with current customer needs and the integrated geospatial solutions focus, so it is expected to stay.
The search extension complements web map applications and the established offer, though it is more niche, so retention remains likely.
